effect.shortEffect: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
effect.full: Raises the user's Speed by three stages when it is hit by a Fire- or Water-type attack. The attack still deals damage.

japanese-kana.swsh: みずタイプ　ほのおタイプの わざを　うけると すばやさが　ぐぐーんと　あがる。

korean.swsh: 물타입이나 불꽃타입 기술을 받으면 스피드가 매우 크게 올라간다.

traditional-chinese.swsh: 受到水屬性或 火屬性招式攻擊時， 速度會極大幅提高。

french.swsh: Lorsque le Pokémon est touché par des capacités de type Eau ou Feu, sa Vitesse augmente énormément.
